description: This file defines a builder class for ImmutableAccessControlList objects, providing methods to create, modify, and build access control lists with a fluent API. It manages ACL entries associated with authorization subjects and is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlListBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder for ImmutableAccessControlList objects, supporting fluent API operations to set, remove, and build ACLs.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder instance initialized with an empty ACL.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with a given iterable of ACL entries.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific ACL entry in the builder.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Replaces current ACL entries with the provided collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific ACL entry from the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an ACL entry associated with a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes multiple ACL entries from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable AccessControlList based on current entries.
